raw: {"analysis":"BGX provides a more complete and actionable plan that correctly maps all repository constraints: unit tests only on PRs, full regression on staging with both team leads' approval, SRE sign-off for production, and explicit handling of the flaky network check. BGX also correctly identifies the downstream reporting team as a necessary reviewer for the irreversible schema change, which FMX omits in favor of generic team lead sign-off. FMX introduces some useful concepts like dead-letter queues and pre-migration snapshots, but its gate structure is more abstract and less precisely tied to the actual approval requirements.","verdict":"BGX"}
